attchmntText: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Receiving of an Additional Order from one of India's leading Public-Sector Oil Marketing Company for Supply of Composite LPG Cylinders for INR 38.14 crore.
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Limited has received an additional order from a public-sector oil marketing company for the supply of Type IV Composite LPG Cylinders. The order quantity has been enhanced from 1,40,000 units to 2,80,000 units. The total order value has increased from approximately Rs. 38.14 crore to Rs. 76.28 crore. The additional order value is Rs. 38.14 crore. The order is domestic in nature. Execution is to be completed within six months. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by promoters or group companies in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall within related party transactions. The announcement was signed by Managing Director Bharat Kumar Vageria.

attchmntText: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Limited has received an order of Rs. 35 Crores, approximately USD 3.68 Million, from its wholly owned subsidiary in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The subsidiary has been awarded an exclusive annual contract by Methanol Chemicals Company, also known as CHEMANOL, for the supply of industrial packaging products including drums, jerry cans, and IBCs. The contract is to be executed within one year. The entity awarding the order is listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange, known as Tadawul. The promoter group and group companies have no interest in the entity that awarded the order. The order is not a related party transaction. This announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Time Technoplast Ltd filed newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 05, 2026. Shree Steel Wire Ropes Limited also published its unaudited financial results for the same period, approved on November 05, 2026. Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited, formerly known as IKS Health, filed its consolidated and standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. These results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 05, 2026. Bajel Projects Limited, formerly known as Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Private Limited, also filed its consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 05, 2026. ICICI Bank Ltd issued a public notice regarding the recovery of dues from legal heirs of a deceased borrower.
